candidate.codeAnchorPolicy: codeCommit is the authoritative candidate demo source identity for fresh V00-V05 and includes the committed 2026-09-15 Local Validation checkpoint. implementationCommit is the last executable/tooling change and remains the Apple Bee implementation anchor validated by Primary CI. Following handoff, source-target, pin and Docs/AssemblyShadow commits are metadata-only under the committed source verifier.

reproduction.preservationPolicy: Do not move this branch for the handoff-contract repair. Preserve the unfixed count behavior and existing validation handoff.

performanceReference.policy: Preserve its own committed old-profile pins. Do not install the candidate runtime into this reference.

primaryValidation.scope: Authenticated Apple Bee graph planning plus portable/host-Clang tool regressions. Not Unity, Apple Player, runtime, or M08 acceptance.

handoffRepair.policy: Keep the preflight executable unchanged; restore its nine-section document contract and rerun authoritative V00 before V01-V05. Future auxiliary validation checkpoints belong under Docs/AssemblyShadow so they do not accidentally become demo build inputs.
